images.prompt: Precise edit of the supplied v2 medal into the same frameless family as the accepted samples. REMOVE the entire LARGE OUTERMOST gold circular frame, its four decorative cardinal diamond points, and the entire large navy circular background plate. Make all removed areas genuinely transparent, including empty gaps between surviving parts. Preserve the actual central subject's recognizable composition, detailed broad gold bevels, modeled thickness and original gold/navy colors. Preserve blue fill ONLY where it is intrinsic to the surviving subject. Do not replace it with an abstract monochrome app icon. Do not create a new enclosing ring, shield, backing disc, scenery or halo. No letters, numerals or text. Center the freed subject with comfortable padding in a square transparent canvas, approximately 85% maximum dimension. No score-tier recoloring. Keep the large central beveled GOLD SQUARE tile and all eight tapered radiating rays around it, preserving the square-and-light identity. The rays form a freestanding starburst whose center is visibly SQUARE. Remove all blue field behind the rays and all outer-circle ornaments. Retain dimensional facets, not just a flat star or glowing dot.
